readback.name: Poincare.ParabolicHessianCarrierPullback.exists_hessian_carrier_pullback
readback.mathematical_statement: E3 is EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3), the real three-dimensional Euclidean vector space in Type 0. Y alpha T V is the pinned normed graph space of total V-valued functions on R x E3 that are zero off the closed cylinder Icc 0 T times all of E3 and have bounded values and bounded scaled differences within that cylinder. Its norm is the value supremum plus the alpha-Hoelder seminorm over distinct ordered cylinder pairs, whose denominator is D(p,q)^alpha with D((t,x),(s,y)) = norm(x-y) + sqrt(abs(t-s)). The inserted zero in these suprema specifies the empty-set case. Y has no separate approximation, smoothness, or continuity condition across the endpoints of the zero extension. There exists one real constant C >= 0 such that for all real alpha,T and every dF in Y alpha T (E3 ->L[R] E3), there exists a continuous real-linear map P from Y alpha T (E3 ->L[R] E3 ->L[R] R) to itself, with operator norm at most C times the square of the whole Y norm of dF. The exponent 2 is the natural-number power of the real number norm(dF), not a pointwise square or a matrix product. For every bilinear carrier B in this space, every p in the entire product R x E3, and every v,w in E3, (P B)(p)(v)(w) = B(p)(dF(p)(v))(dF(p)(w)). Both vector arguments are transformed by the same dF(p), while B is evaluated at the original point p. There is no spatial composition or base-point change in this identity. The notation dF denotes an arbitrary Y-valued field of continuous real-linear endomorphisms; the hypotheses do not assert that it is the derivative of an underlying function. Neither dF nor B is required to be symmetric, invertible, or spatially smooth. C is quantified before alpha,T,dF and is uniform over all these inputs. P may depend on alpha,T,dF and is linear in B, whereas the contraction is quadratic in the dF field. No sign or upper-bound restriction is imposed on alpha, and all real T are included, with an empty cylinder for T < 0 and a single-time spatial slice for T = 0. The identity covers points outside the cylinder as well, where the Y fields vanish. The assertion constructs a bounded carrier contraction and does not assert the spatial Hessian chain rule, a derivative certificate, or a Graph operator. The declaration has no universe parameters. Inside the universal alpha,T,dF clause and before the existential P, the revised literal type locally selects NormedSpace R (Y alpha T Hess) using Mathlib Submodule.normedSpace applied to the very holderSubmodule whose subtype defines this Y, with Hess = E3 ->L[R] E3 ->L[R] R. This is the standard inherited normed-space instance for that existing submodule. It retains the Y norm defined by the underlying WithLp 1 ambient product, hence the sum of the same value supremum and Hoelder seminorm, and the usual inherited real module structure. NormedSpace uses the already supplied seminormed additive group and does not introduce a new norm; the local instance only provides the canonical scalar-norm compatibility for this exact subtype. It adds no mathematical hypothesis, does not quantify over a different instance, and does not reinterpret the operator norm or the quadratic estimate. The displayed local letI therefore leaves the mathematical assertion described above unchanged.
